Pastel 1922 Exhibited 1923 Anderson Gallery. Property of Sherwood Anderson" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "O'Keeffe dates it to 1921. Betty Pilkington 1957." Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1921. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, date 1922. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 12, 16. See cat. nos. 381, 382, 384–87. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: The White Wave

description: Horizontal pastel of white, grey, and grayish-blue wave-like formations with areas of the paper exposed.  In the center is a grey-blue triangular shape, and below it on the page are rippling lines of grey on white.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
